quests.title: Short Delivery, Leichhardt North
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. The Leichhardt North order has been two cartons light every week since the week of the show and the invoice says otherwise every time. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Leichhardt North
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $73 owing to Leichhardt North and it is not going to walk in here itself. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: $73, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Leichhardt North Run
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I do the Leichhardt North run at half six and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Hawthorne
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Leichhardt North
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. I have got a bucket of odd keys in the back of the van and the Leichhardt North shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Leichhardt North
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. Three of the Leichhardt North regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $39 down on those days. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$39, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Leichhardt North
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Everything Leichhardt North sells comes off a floor at Lilyfield, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Newtown
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Newtown on Thursdays and one of them has a note from his mother. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Newtown
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. We found a twelfth, which means the Newtown club now owes the association $66 it had budgeted on not owing. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: $66 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Newtown Canteen
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. The canteen at Newtown does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at quarter to six. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Newtown
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Somebody walked off with the float from the Newtown canteen at about quarter to six during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$84, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Newtown
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The sprinkler line under the Newtown outfield has been leaking since Thursdays and the wet patch has started to move. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Newtown
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at St Peters, and Newtown has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.title: The Creek Behind Panania
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind Panania since the long weekend and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: the fill, with the water level in shot
the council reads photographs, not letters

quests.title: Willow Removal, Panania
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. They have agreed to a clean-up at Panania, which is wonderful, except the grant is $110 short and closes on the long weekend. I have rung the number on the letter four times. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: $110, and I do not care whose pocket
the form needs the number today

quests.title: Sandbags, Panania
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. We had 10 sandbags in the Panania shed on the long weekend and this morning we have got the pallet they came on. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the yards backing onto the reserve
anywhere they have obviously been used

quests.title: The Low Crossing, Panania
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. People keep driving the low crossing at Panania at just gone midnight with the water over the sign, and one of them is going to be the one. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: you will be standing out there a while
the ones who argue with the barrier

quests.title: Under the House, Panania
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The water came through my place at Panania on the long weekend and the assessor wants photographs of things I have already thrown out. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. I will know if you skipped a bit.

steps.label: round the side, where the pile is
the high-water mark on the brick
that is the whole claim, that mark

quests.title: Upstream, Panania
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. Whatever is happening to Panania starts upstream at Revesby, and there are people up there who have been saying so for years. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: go up and find them
I want to hear it from someone who is not me
